issues.description: fieldsWriter throws UnsupportedOperationException while public constructor and SPI registration still hand out instances
issues.detail: KnnVectorsFormat.fieldsWriter is contractually expected to return a writer; the legacy formats now throw at write time even though the no-arg public constructor remains SPI-listed. This is both an LSP violation (runtime-encoded read-only contract) and a wrong failure point. Fail at construction or express read-only in the type via a ReadOnlyKnnVectorsFormat supertype.

issues.description: Public API surface demoted to package-private in the same release as the relocation without a deprecation cycle
issues.detail: NAME, QUANTIZED_VECTOR_COMPONENT, and calculateDefaultConfidenceInterval were public on a released format class. Narrowing visibility while relocating is an undeclared ABI break. Keep symbols public-and-deprecated for one release cycle before removal.

issues.description: Module boundary violated: backward_codecs imports core lucene99 internals
issues.detail: Moved classes still import org.apache.lucene.codecs.lucene99.Lucene99HnswVectorsFormat/Reader and Lucene99FlatVectorsFormat. backward_codecs is meant to be a sealed legacy boundary; coupling it to current core means future core changes can silently break legacy read paths. Copy needed pieces in or share via a stable interface.

issues.description: Patch conflates relocation, visibility narrowing, and write-path disablement into one commit
issues.detail: The diff's similarity-index headers (91-98%) hide semantic changes inside what reads like a rename. Split into three patches: pure move, visibility/deprecation, and write-disable. This makes review tractable and bisection meaningful.

issues.description: OffHeapQuantizedByteVectorValues fields demoted from protected to package-private while class stays public abstract
issues.detail: The class is still public abstract, so external subtypes were implicitly invited, yet they can no longer access the previously protected fields. Either seal/finalize the class or restore the protected contract; the current half-step leaves a public ADT with no usable extension surface.

issues.description: Dead numMergeWorkers/mergeExec parameters still accepted and validated by constructor
issues.detail: The constructor accepts and null-checks numMergeWorkers and mergeExec, then discards them. Since writes now throw anyway, drop the parameters or document them as ignored source-compat shims. As written it reads like a half-done refactor.

synthesis.summary: The panel agrees the relocation of Lucene99 scalar-quantized formats into backward_codecs is directionally correct but contract work and patch hygiene are incomplete. The biggest issues are the runtime-throwing fieldsWriter on classes still constructible via SPI (an LSP violation and wrong failure point) and an undeclared ABI break from demoting public symbols in the same release as the move. The new backward_codecs classes also still import core lucene99 internals, leaving the module boundary porous. Verdict: NEEDS-WORK. Split the patch into move / visibility / write-disable, introduce a ReadOnlyKnnVectorsFormat supertype (or fail at construction), keep removed symbols deprecated for one cycle, and sever the residual core imports.
